newsitem.title: USA: Greystone Technology to go public with purchase.
newsitem.headline: Greystone Technology to go public with purchase.

text.p: Greystone Technology Inc said it will become a public company by purchasing the shares of Express Capital Concepts in what the company calls a reverse merger agreement. The terms of the agreement have not been finalized.

In a statement, Greystone Technology said Express Capital Concepts is likely to conduct a reverse split of its publically traded stock, leaving the number of outstanding shares at 480,000. Greystone said it is anticipated that it will end up with 97 percent ownership of Express Capital's stock. The company told Reuters it is now in a quiet period, declined to give a total value to the deal.

Express Capital's chief executive officer, Ernest Mathis told Reuters, "based on today's market value of our stock, after the conversions, the total market cap of the new company would be roughly $133 million."
Greystone Technology designs, develops and markets real-time, interactive and 3-Dimensional software for the entertainment and defense industries.
